gaps.reason: Conditional options and standardized patch formats are not in the method workflows.
coap-rs answers a skipped Block1 number with 2.31. A server-requested smaller Block1 size is not a process case.
Protected Observe, concurrent contexts, and persistent sender state are not process cases.
libcoap does not implement Q-Block in this suite.
Echo, Request-Tag, problem details, and 4.xx/5.xx No-Response are not process cases.
No discovery or delayed-completion process cases.
No process X.509 cases against libcoap.
These DTLS fixtures have no raw public key.
ETSI DTLS cipher, Finished, alert, and loss schedules are not process cases.
Scoped IPv6, reorder, delay, and MTU cases are absent.
Serial sessions and 140-session churn are not a concurrent soak.
Process runs do not measure MCU stack or runtime.
No fuzz or requirements-coverage campaign in this suite.
coap-rs and libcoap apply a duplicated counter POST twice.
